CITY OF ALHAMBRA PLANNING COMMISSION
  ACTION MINUTES

  Regular Meeting
  March 20, 2023

A.  CALL MEETING TO ORDER: 7:00 P.M. in the Council Chambers of Alhambra City Hall,
  and via video conference and teleconference.

B.  ROLL CALL:
  Present:  Grijalva, Ho, Juarez, Olson, Pham, Tsujii, Wang, Garcia, Gardea

  Absent:  Mojarro

  Staff Present: Vanessa Reynoso, Deputy Director; Paul Lam, Principal Planner; Maia
  McCurley, Senior Planner; Erica Vega, Deputy City Attorney

C.  FLAG SALUTE:  Led by President Gardea

D.  CONSENT AGENDA:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 1:  MINUTES – FEBRUARY 21, 2023 (7:01 P.M.)
  • Request: This is a request for the Planning Commission to approve
  the Minutes of the February 21, 2023, Regular Meeting of the
  Alhambra Planning Commission.
  • Recommended Action: Commission review and approve as
  submitted the Minutes of the February 21, 2023, Regular Meeting of
  the Alhambra Planning Commission.

  MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve Consent Agenda Item 1.
  •  Moved by Commissioner Olson, Seconded by Commissioner Wang.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 8-0-1-1
  Ayes:  Grijalva, Ho, Olson, Pham, Tsujii, Wang, Garcia, Gardea
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: Juarez
  Absent: Mojarro

  AGENDA
  ITEM 2:  EXTENSION FOR TENTATIVE TRACT MAP TT 083279 (7:02 P.M.)
  • Request: This is a request for a one-year extension for the previously
  approved Tentative Tract Map TT 083279 to allow the development
  1
  03/20/2023
   of a 10,494 square foot, nine (9) unit residential condominium
  complex on a site of approximately 17,800 square feet located at 209
  North Monterey Street in the R-3 (Multiple Family Residential) zone.
  •  Recommended Action: Adopt Resolution 23-05 approving an
  extension to April 5, 2024, for Tentative Tract Map TT 083279
  subject to the Conditions of Approval, and finding the extension for
  TT 083279 to be exempt from review under the California
  Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) pursuant to Section 15332, Class
  32 of Title 14 of the California Code of Regulations, which exempts
  from CEQA review projects characterized as in-fill development.

  MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve Consent Agenda Item 2.
  •  Moved by Commissioner Ho, Seconded by Commissioner Wang.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 9-0-0-1
  Ayes:  Grijalva, Ho, Juarez, Olson, Pham, Tsujii, Wang, Garcia,
  Gardea
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent: Mojarro

  recordings of the discussion is available here:

E.  DISCUSSION ITEMS:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 3:  ZONING CODE UPDATE (7:04 P.M.)
  • This is the fifth continuation of the eighth presentation in a series of
  presentations on the Comprehensive Zoning Code Update project
  presented by Planning Division Staff.
  • Recommended Action: It is recommended that the Planning
  Commission receive and file this informational report and provide
  input to Staff as deemed appropriate.
  • Public Comments:
  1.) Jennifer Ng
  • Commissioner Comments:
  2
  03/20/2023
   1.) Commissioner Wang
  2.) President Gardea
•  Principal Planner Paul Lam provided the Staff presentation.
•  Motion on Comment #14 (Veterinary Services):
  o Moved to approve requirement for a Minor Use Permit (MUP) for
  Veterinary Services uses in the CMU (Commercial Mixed-Use)
  zone.
  o Moved by Commissioner Ho, Seconded by Commissioner Olson.
  o The motion carried by a Voice Vote with a majority of the
  Commission voting in favor of the motion.
•  Motion on Comment #14 (Custom Manufacturing and Food &
  Beverage Manufacturing, Small):
  o Moved to approve requirement for a Minor Use Permit (MUP) for
  Customer Manufacturing uses and Food & Beverage
  Manufacturing, Small uses in the CMU (Commercial Mixed-Use)
  zone.
  o Moved by Vice President Garcia, Seconded by Commissioner Ho.
  o The motion carried by a Voice Vote with a majority of the
  Commission voting in favor of the motion.
•  Motion on Comment #14 (Personal Storage):
  o Moved to approve requirement for a Conditional Use Permit
  (CUP) for Personal Storage uses in the CMU (Commercial
  Mixed-Use) zone.
  o Moved by Commissioner Tsujii, Seconded by Commissioner
  Wang.
  o The motion carried by a Voice Vote with a majority of the
  Commission voting in favor of the motion.
•  Motion on Comment #14 (Veterinary Services, Custom
  Manufacturing, and Food & Beverage Manufacturing, Small):
  o Moved to approve requirement for a Minor Use Permit (MUP) for
  Veterinary Services uses, Custom Manufacturing uses, and Food
  & Beverage Manufacturing, Small uses in the CMU (Commercial
  Mixed-Use), EMC (East Main Commercial), and CBD (Central
  Business District) zones.
  o Moved by Vice President Garcia, Seconded by Commissioner
  Olson.
  o The motion carried by a Voice Vote with a majority of the
  Commission voting in favor of the motion.
•  Recess at 7:51 P.M.
•  Reconvene at 8:00 P.M.
•  Motion on Comment #20:
  o Moved to approve with Staff’s recommendation to eliminate the
  RC Overlay.
  o The motion carried by a Voice Vote with a majority of the
  Commission voting in favor of the motion.
•  Motion on Comment #26:
  o Moved to approve with Staff’s recommendation.
  3
  03/20/2023
   o Moved by Commissioner Tsujii, Seconded by Commissioner Ho.
  o The motion carried by a Voice Vote with a majority of the
  Commission voting in favor of the motion.
•  Motion on Comment #27:
  o Moved to approve 1:250 off-street parking ratio for the gross floor
  area of food service uses.
  o Moved by Vice President Garcia, Seconded by Commissioner
  Olson.
  o The motion carried by a Voice Vote with a majority of the
  Commission voting in favor of the motion.
•  Motion on Comment #28:
  o Moved to approve exempting outdoor dining areas not exceeding
  50% of a restaurant’s gross floor area from off-street parking
  requirements.
  o Moved by Commissioner Ho, Seconded by Commissioner Wang.
  o The motion carried by a Voice Vote with a majority of the
  Commission voting in favor of the motion.
•  Motion on Comment #29:
  o Moved to approve with Staff’s recommendation.
  o Moved by Commissioner Ho, Seconded by Commissioner Olson.
  o The motion carried by a Voice Vote with a majority of the
  Commission voting in favor of the motion.
•  Recess at 9:13 P.M.
•  Reconvene at 9:20 P.M.
•  Motion on Comment #30:
  o Moved to approve with Staff’s recommendation.
  o Moved by Commissioner Wang, Seconded by Commissioner Ho.
  o The motion carried by a Voice Vote with a majority of the
  Commission voting in favor of the motion.
•  Motion on Comment #31:
  o Moved to approve with Staff’s recommendation.
  o Moved by Commissioner Olson, Seconded by Commissioner
  Wang.
  o The motion carried by a Voice Vote with a majority of the
  Commission voting in favor of the motion.
•  Motion on Comment #32:
  o Moved to approve with Staff’s recommendation.
  o Moved by Commissioner Ho, Seconded by Commissioner
  Grijalva.
  o The motion carried by a Voice Vote with a majority of the
  Commission voting in favor of the motion.
•  Motion on Comment #33:
  o Moved to approve with Staff’s recommendation.
  o Moved by Vice President Garcia, Seconded by Commissioner
  Pham.
  o The motion carried by a Voice Vote with a majority of the
  Commission voting in favor of the motion.
  4
  03/20/2023
   •  Motion on Comment #34:
  o Moved to approve with Staff’s recommendation.
  o Moved by Commissioner Ho, Seconded by Commissioner Olson.
  o The motion carried by a Voice Vote with a majority of the
  Commission voting in favor of the motion.
  •  Motion on Comment #35:
  o Moved to approve with Staff’s recommendation.
  o Moved by Commissioner Ho, Seconded by Commissioner Pham.
  o The motion carried by a Voice Vote with a majority of the
  Commission voting in favor of the motion.
  •  Motion on Comment #36:
  o Moved to approve with Staff’s recommendation.
  o Moved by Commissioner Olson, Seconded by Vice President
  Garcia.
  o The motion carried by a Voice Vote with a majority of the
  Commission voting in favor of the motion.
  •  Motion on Comment #37:
  o Moved to approve with Staff’s recommendation.
  o Moved by Commissioner Olson, Seconded by Commissioner Ho.
  o The motion carried by a Voice Vote with a majority of the
  Commission voting in favor of the motion.
  •  Motion on Comment #38, 39, 40, 41, and 42:
  o Moved to continue discussion to next regular Planning
  Commission meeting.
  o Moved by Commissioner Wang, Seconded by Commissioner
  Olson.
  o The motion carried by a Voice Vote with a majority of the
  Commission voting in favor of the motion.

F.  ORAL COMMUNICATIONS:

  •  Lewis McCammon discussed inconsistencies between the General Plan land use map
  and the Zoning map, and commented on the need to address these inconsistencies as
  part of the Zoning Code update. Mr. McCammon also discussed building height
  standards in the City. (10:06 P.M.)

  5
  03/20/2023
   •  Shirley Tatsuno commented on multi-family design guidelines and expressed concern
  with proposed building height and residential density standards. (10:13 P.M.)

  •  Jennifer Ng commented on the need to establish a consistent dividing line between
  the CBD (Central Business District) zone and the EMC (East Main Commercial) zone.
  (10:15 P.M.)

  •  Ari Gutierrrez Arambula commented on developing standards for digital billboards;
  prioritizing full utilization of the CBD for commercial and residential uses; and
  addressing transportation issues in the City concurrently with housing planning efforts.
  (10:16 P.M.)
